recognize_zh: 中央一個核較大、胞質淡且含碎屑的巨噬細胞，周圍環繞一圈核圓而深染、胞質深藍的晚期紅血球前驅細胞，呈玫瑰花環狀排列，即骨髓中的紅血球島（erythroid island），屬正常結構。
features: Central macrophage with an oval, finely reticulated nucleus and pale, ill-defined cytoplasm containing small granules/debris
Ring of erythroid precursors (polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts) surrounding the macrophage
Erythroid precursors with round, dense, clumped nuclei and deeply basophilic to grey-blue cytoplasm
Background of neutrophils, band forms and myelocytes with granular cytoplasm
Numerous red cells; intense blue hue of MGG stain in this preparation
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a central macrophage with an oval nucleus and pale, finely granular cytoplasm surrounded by a rosette of maturing erythroid precursors with round, condensed nuclei and basophilic to polychromatic cytoplasm. Background granulocytic precursors and neutrophils appear morphologically unremarkable. No dysplastic erythroid features (nuclear budding, multinuclearity, megaloblastoid chromatin) are evident in this field. Findings are consistent with a normal erythroblastic island.

ddx.vs: In hemophagocytosis the erythroid cells are engulfed within the macrophage cytoplasm, whereas in an erythroid island they are arranged around the outside of the macrophage.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor cluster
ddx.vs: Tumor clusters are cohesive groups of larger, atypical cells with nuclear molding and fine chromatin and lack a central macrophage and orderly erythroid maturation.
Lymphocytes have scant pale blue cytoplasm and coarse but less dense chromatin, and do not form a rosette around a central macrophage.
